query: Ryzen 7 9850X3D price in stock November 2026 retail
answer: The Ryzen 7 9850X3D is available for $484.00 on Newegg as of November 9, 2026. Other prices listed include €574 in the Netherlands, €561 in another EU listing, €595 in France, and $502 in the US, though this US listing is out of stock. AMD has confirmed the release date and price, which is likely around $499-$549. The MSRP is $499, $20 more than the 9800X3D’s launch price.

results.title: AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D price listed by first retailers - VideoCardz.com
results.content:
Outside Germany, a Netherlands listing shows the 9850X3D at €574. Another EU listing shows €561. Some screenshots are far higher. French retailer lists the CPU at €595 and €714 with VAT included. A US store page shows $502, but the item is marked out of stock.

These early prices mix VAT and pre-VAT entries and look like placeholder retail data. AMD’s official pricing will matter more than the first wave of store pages.

### 9850X3D prices [...] Retail pages for AMD’s Ryzen 7 9850X3D are starting to appear across multiple stores. The screenshots show large pricing differences between countries and even within the same market.

In Germany, one retailer lists the Ryzen 7 9850X3D at €530 for a “Slot-in” entry and €561 for a boxed version, both plus shipping. For reference, the same store shows the Ryzen 7 9800X3D at €435 (shipping) and €478 (pickup), plus shipping. [...] AMD is very likely to announce pricing today (it’s exactly a week before launch). If we were to make an educated guess, the price is likely around $499-$549.

Update: AMD has confirmed the release date and price.

Many thanks to LisaCEOAMD for the tip! (yes, that’s the actual name of Tipper)
